description:
Whether you're striving for a new personal best, staying on top of your daily progress, or elevating your overall health journey, Samsung Health brings it all together in one place, helping you work towards your personal goals.

Build your own Fitness Index with Samsung Health: 
1. Set goals that are right for you
2. Track 5 key metrics: Strength, Cardio, Endurance, Flexibility, and Body Composition
3. Get workouts tailored to you
4. Build your own Fitness Index

Take your fitness further. Make it yours. Your health in one place. Learn more: http://smsng.co/SamsungHealth_FitnessIndex_yt
